name: dry_run:log-email-app-info-sent-confirmation-to-1f3c:5bbc06a8
query:
fetch logs, from: -24h, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "email"
| summarize scope_records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    target_records = countIf(service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_records = countIf(service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    outside_target = countIf((service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user")) and not (service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user"))) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_errors = countIf((service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user")) and in(loglevel, {"ERROR", "FATAL"})) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio)
